changes_vs_current: New topic. Scope: groups only. Solo acts and bands named after a frontman (Springsteen & E Street, Tom Petty & the Heartbreakers, Bob Seger & Silver Bullet, Santana) are left out, and so are acts that are not mainly rock (Bee Gees, Simon & Garfunkel, Maroon 5). The raw average across 6 people sources ran Beatles, Stones, Zeppelin, Fleetwood Mac, AC/DC, Eagles, Queen, Pink Floyd, Aerosmith, Metallica, GNR, Bon Jovi, Journey, RHCP, Linkin Park, CCR, Green Day, Nirvana, Beach Boys, Skynyrd, U2, Van Halen, KISS, Coldplay. Gut-check moves: Queen went from #7 to #3. It is tied #1 in YouGov popularity and #3 on Spotify, and the raw average is held down only by the 1999 Gallup poll, which predates the band's 2018 revival. Nirvana went from #18 to #11. It is YouGov #11, Spotify #12 and Wikipedia #16, is missing from both old polls and sits low on RIAA because of its short career, and it is a top-6 gut answer. Fleetwood Mac drops from #4 to #7 to make room. Its data is strong (YouGov #3, Wikipedia #2), but people name it less often as a 'rock band'. Coldplay (#24 raw, 25.2) is left out in favour of The Doors (#26 raw, 26.3, five sources, including Gallup). Coldplay's score comes almost entirely from global Spotify, and Americans rarely name it as a rock band. Radiohead (#25 raw) is left out for the same reason.
confidence: High for the top 5. The Beatles are #1 in every source, and the Stones, Zeppelin, Queen and AC/DC are top-10 in most. Medium-high for #6-13 (Eagles, Fleetwood Mac, Pink Floyd, Aerosmith, Metallica, Nirvana, GNR, Bon Jovi). These are clearly top-15 bands, but their order is close and depends on the source: Metallica is low in YouGov popularity and high in pageviews and sales. Medium for #14-20, where generations disagree: Linkin Park, Green Day and RHCP are strong on streaming and pageviews but missing from the polls, while CCR, the Beach Boys and Skynyrd lean on older audiences. Low-medium for #21-24. Near misses are The Who, Pearl Jam, Def Leppard, Foo Fighters, Black Sabbath, ZZ Top, Chicago, Foreigner, The Police, Grateful Dead and Coldplay. The polls are old (Gallup 1999, Monmouth 2018), and I could not open a current YouGov 'favorite band' poll. YouGov popularity data was read only from the top 20 of each category page and from individual topic pages.
